PLAN "Post-MI Cardiac-Safe General Fitness - 12 Weeks"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary general_fitness:
    name "Safe aerobic and strength base, HR under 115 bpm, no valsalva"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Full Body A":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press 2x12..15 rpe 4 rest 120 seconds
          seated_row 2x12..15 rpe 4 rest 120 seconds
          dumbbell_press 2x12..15 rpe 4 rest 120 seconds
          glute_bridge 2x12..15 rpe 4 rest 90 seconds
          bird_dog 2x8..10 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
          hamstring_stretch 2m
          chest_stretch 2m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Aerobic Base":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          marching 2x20..30 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          diaphragmatic_breathing 2x8..10 rpe 2 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          cycling 20m
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Full Body B":
        warmup:
          cycling 10m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 2x12..15 rpe 4 rest 120 seconds
          lat_pulldown 2x12..15 rpe 4 rest 120 seconds
